data.title: Rami Katkhuda Reiterates Buy on Trutakna, Citing Strong Clinical and Early Commercial Traction; $90 Price Target Maintained
data.description:
LifeSci Capital analyst Rami Katkhuda has maintained their bullish stance on VERA stock, giving a Buy rating today.

Rami Katkhuda has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, primarily the robust, long‑term clinical performance of Trutakna in IgA nephropathy and the drug’s ability to slow kidney function decline in line with disease‑modifying expectations. He highlights that Trutakna substantially reduces progression events versus placebo over two years, with a clean safety profile that closely tracks placebo and avoids serious infection or immune‑related complications.

Katkhuda also points to the early commercial traction following accelerated approval, with strong initial patient start form activity and emerging reimbursement support that signal solid uptake potential. Against a backdrop of high unmet need in IgAN and favorable positioning relative to competing agents, he believes these data support durable adoption and justify maintaining a $90 price target, underscoring attractive upside from current levels.

data.title: Rocket Pharmaceuticals: FDA Alignment De-Risks Danon Program, Safety Data Strengthens Outlook as Buy Rating Reiterated with Unchanged $15 Price Target
data.description:
In a report released today, Yun Zhong from Wedbush maintained a Buy rating on Rocket Pharmaceuticals, with a price target of $15.00.

Yun Zhong has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors highlighting both clinical and financial strength at Rocket Pharmaceuticals. He views the recent alignment with the FDA on the pivotal Phase 2 RP-A501 study in Danon disease as a major de-risking event, with the trial design, patient number, and key efficacy endpoints preserved, restoring momentum after prior delays and enhancing the probability of eventual approval.

He also notes that safety concerns have been addressed through a lower recalibrated dose and removal of the C3 complement inhibitor, with new data from three patients showing good tolerability and no serious AAV-related complications. Combined with encouraging efficacy signals from earlier pediatric patients, a clear path to completing Phase 2 dosing by mid-2027, and a cash runway extending into the second quarter of 2028, he sees substantial upside relative to the unchanged $15 price target and therefore maintains a Buy recommendation on RCKT.
